mapper.sql: select p.id, p.user_id, p.real_name, p.gender, p.id_card, p.phone, p.organization, p.major_or_class, p.specialty, p.emergency_contact, p.emergency_phone, p.audit_status, p.audit_reason, p.auditor_id, p.auditor_name, p.audit_time, p.total_service_minutes, p.service_count, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.status as user_status from vol_volunteer_profile p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.user_id
mapper.select:
and p.user_id = #{userId} and p.real_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%') and p.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%') and p.organization like concat('%', #{organization}, '%') and p.audit_status = #{auditStatus} and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
order by p.create_time desc, p.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into vol_volunteer_profile( user_id, real_name, gender, id_card, phone, organization, major_or_class, specialty, emergency_contact, emergency_phone, audit_status, audit_reason, auditor_id, auditor_name, audit_time, total_service_minutes, service_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark ) values ( #{userId}, #{realName}, #{gender}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{organization}, #{majorOrClass}, #{specialty}, #{emergencyContact}, #{emergencyPhone}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditReason}, #{auditorId}, #{auditorName}, #{auditTime}, #{totalServiceMinutes}, #{serviceCount}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark} )
